collection.description: A trader discovers a discrepancy in the village's exchange records, and neighbors begin whispering about dishonesty.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (trader), a trader, discovers a discrepancy in the village's exchange records, and neighbors begin whispering about dishonesty.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: A misplaced bundle resolves the discrepancy and ends the suspicion.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The count confirms a shortage but reveals no evidence of theft.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An ambiguous symbol caused two people to record the same exchange differently.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The records are accurate, so the village examines transport and storage losses.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (trader) feels less isolated while the investigation continues.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Some remain suspicious, prompting a discussion of evidence and reputation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: A simple double-check prevents future mistakes.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The new system proves cumbersome, and traders refine it after a trial.
